Server.Name: USS New Jersey Battleship Museum Challenge V.3.3
Server.Description:
An overhaul mod pack for Release Ver.3.3 (B13) Stable.
This mod pack was created for a solo or dual survival challenge onboard an US Iowa-class Battleship (USS New Jersey BB-62), concept design and custom POIs engineered by Devilskut.
MAIN FEATURE OVERHAUL: - This mod pack fully incorporates an accelerated "Learn by Doing" progression system powered by Spherii's custom mod engine. Your skills dynamically improve as you perform tasks in the field, bypassing standard rigid level gates for a more natural, responsive tactical growth curve.
Notes about this mini-mod changes and mechanics: - Map and Logistics: Features five (5) existing pre-generated custom worlds allowing you to choose your starting area biome—Forest, Burnt, Desert, Snow, or the ultimate challenge, Wasteland. - Important Tool Warning: Everything MUST be wrenched. - Naval Fortifications and Transport: Deploys heavy automated defenses including 5D CWIS Turrets, 5D Patriot Mobile Launchers/Trailers, alongside tactical vehicle assets like the ATV Puma and Military Trailer. - Custom made Battleship Museum POI, giving you everything you need to be able to complete your quests. - Custom questline and challenges page to help guide you on your way.
THE Battleship Museum Challenge:
CHALLENGE RULES:
1: You must stay within the Battleship Museum grounds until you can build a repair kit and find your gyrocopter.
2: The rubble on the ground and water around the Battleship is spicy and as such may NOT be used to support any structures, or to grow any crops, unless you can do this WITHOUT touching it.
3: You may NOT mine or dig under the Battleship.
4: You may only use one of the Six (6) Group preset difficulties, It's recommended to have respawns set to 5 days groups and 7 days solo and turn airdrops OFF.
5: Trader Hours are set to 6 AM and 12pm (noon) sharp!
6: You must survive until you are able to repair your gyrocopter and fly to your Trader.
